question: Approve the design and enter implementation? Approving accepts D1 (an idle-hook line: dispatch_records.py --newest scans the newest committed record and pr_watch.py tasks prints one next: line while a bare script name remains) and D2 (FO drafts an issue asking Spacedock for a pre-dispatch hook point and shows it to you before posting; nothing is posted on this approval), each as recommended. It also accepts the batch-1 implementation order (names-check-before-dispatch lands before extension-instruction-reaches-dispatch, which edits the same dispatch_records.py function; the other three run in parallel), and is the grant for the implementation worker to push a branch and open a Draft PR.

artifacts.summary: Design: the --names check cannot be forced before dispatch build (no Spacedock pre-dispatch hook; ADR 0014 met the same wall), so it runs automatically at FO's idle hook and detects after the commit, not before the send; no README or mod words added. Replay: flags exactly the three missed records (e081c5f2, c3935e01, d6182ead) and no other active task; 55 of 149 record additions over history, 5 of 71 since 2026-10-14. Not measured: whether the line reaches FO before the worker reads the record. Changes dispatch_records.py, pr_watch.py and tests. design_surfaces.py check exit 0.
